verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI supports long-running/resumable crawls (resume_state, on_state_change callbacks), deep crawling, and a Docker/FastAPI server plus MCP integration, which could underpin background automation, but there is no evidence of a scheduler, trigger system, or persistent autonomous job runner that operates without manual invocation. missing for 10: no documented scheduling/cron or event-triggered automation, no evidence of a standalone background agent loop, no independent confirmation of unattended multi-step autonomous runs.
